name: Amazing facts
description: Numbered lists of surprising, true facts about nature, science and the world around us.

definition.brief: Each video counts through surprising, true facts about one subject from nature, science, space or everyday life. Every fact is accurate and checkable, explained in plain words, and comes with one vivid detail that makes it easy to remember. Never invent numbers or records.
definition.music_mood: light, upbeat electronic music with soft plucked synths and a steady beat, curious and bright

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Here are today's facts!

outro_line.en: Thanks for watching. See you soon for more facts!
outro_line.ta: பார்த்ததற்கு நன்றி. மேலும் உண்மைகளுடன் விரைவில் சந்திப்போம்!
